continuation.text:
The Friday rule was already in `src/solution.py`, so I left it as it was: a Friday meeting can't start after 15:00. I made one small change and didn't run any tests or checks on it.

- **Back-to-back meetings:** the old code added one extra minute after every event. That blocked a meeting starting exactly when another ended, even though they don't overlap. I removed the extra minute, so back-to-back meetings are now allowed.
- **Tidy-ups:** I simplified the Friday latest-start calculation and the merging of blocked time ranges. I also fixed the garbled lunch-break dash in the comments. None of these change behaviour.

I kept the 12:00–13:00 lunch break, the 09:00–17:00 working hours and the 15-minute start times, since the code already used them. The requirements don't mention the lunch break, so you may want to drop it.
